name: Bhagavad Gita 6.17
text:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
meaning: For one who is moderate in eating and recreation, balanced in effort, and moderate in sleep and waking, yoga becomes the remover of sorrow.
purpose: Balance in food, recreation, effort, sleep and waking; useful for reflecting on sustainable routines.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
